extension.summary: Sync Kodi favourites.xml with cloud storage
extension.description: Synchronise Kodi favourites across devices using WebDAV, S3, SFTP, SMB/NAS, NFS, or local paths. Supports bidirectional merge, scheduled sync, and conflict resolution.
extension.news: v1.0.68: Multi-profile awareness - manage separate sync configs per Kodi profile, cross-add favourites to other profiles, auto-sync on profile startup/shutdown
